name: Stennes
description: Stennes were a Near-Human sentient species from the planet Stennaros. A Force-sensitive offshoot of their species, the Stennes Shifters, were subject to millennia of persecution that led to many Stennes also being killed. As a result, the Stennes also persecuted the Shifters, and were a xenophobic species that avoided outside contact, but were socially and culturally advanced within their native Stennaros system.
